request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rollover now soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

The change is in `rollover` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/PeriodService.java`:

- **When:** the soft-closes run after the `ROLLOVER` audit line is recorded.
- **Which periods:** every old-year period that is neither closed nor soft-closed, in start-date order. Periods already closed or soft-closed are left alone.
- **How:** each one goes through the same path a manual soft close uses, so it fixes the same figures and pool cuts and writes the same `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED ... total=...` line. These run inside the rollover's one transaction, so if the rollover is refused, nothing is written.

I also updated the method's comment to describe the new step. No schema or front-end change was needed.

Undoing a rollover still only removes the new periods and takes back the opening balances. It does not reopen the periods the rollover soft-closed. The request didn't cover undo, so I left it as is; reopening them would be a separate change.
